description: One characteristic of the board's GATT table as a way, both ways: the provider's frames go out on it as notifications, what the client writes comes in (PROVIDER_BLE.MD). A side that is not wanted is a link the data matrix does not have. Its service is made when it is new.

fields.label: Service
fields.description: The 16-bit UUID of the service they are in: made when it is new

fields.label: Characteristic
fields.description: The 16-bit UUID of the characteristic: notify out, written by the client in

fields.label: Flags
fields.description: provider_ble_flag: PROVIDER_BLE_FRAMED, the characteristic carries frames (a session's way); else raw bytes

fields.label: Write flags
fields.description: cmd_send_flag of each write out of the port: CMD_SEND_NOWAIT, the BLE host never waits

fields.label: Name
fields.description: The user description of the characteristic (descriptor 0x2901), NUL-ended; empty: none
